title: ws-hwdrivers stream 3: charging-case box-detect trio verified function-level vs stock (Renode 1.17 cortex-m55)

method.harness: build/ws-hwdrivers-20261122/harness; gen_boxcase.c, gen_svcbox.c, gen_uartmgr.c produced by autogen.py (callee/data stock addresses resolved from name suffix, apollo_main.tsv, source RAM/Stock comments, and a known-callee table; arg types from clang AST)
method.design: stock bodies run in place from stock.app.bin @0x00438000; reconstructed C linked into ITCM. Intra-module calls resolve within each variant (stock-for-stock, C-for-C). Cross-module callees patched to logging/modelled stubs at their stock addresses for both variants (osTimer*/osDelay no-op; audio_log_flags/compress_log_output/audio_log_extended; audio_queue_copy_bytes memcpy; audio_uart_buffer_zero; hal_uart_* ; pt_protocol_dispatch / pt_production_mode_orchestrate; audio_ble_device_manager_send @0x4C659A; npmx_interrupt_handler; display/sync/reset callees). RAM state globals (box case state 0x20074928, timers 0x20074920/24, rx slot 0x20074f96, rx buffers 0x2005ba68, g2_npmx_instance 0x20070f78, sensor/local scratch) seeded identically before each test and diffed after.
method.compare: per test: return value (void ignored), caller output struct (SCRATCH), every seeded RAM region, I2C/stub semantic traces (device addr/register/bytes, buffer lengths/fill, request app/len/payload). Comparator normalizes differing stack-temporary addresses and validates segment framing.
method.inputs: 25 randomized cases per function, run stock vs C, with audio_log_flags()=0 and =7.

intentional_divergence: box_uart_mgr DEV_BoxRevcMsgProcess_53a0b6 adds a non-stock openCFW call g2_recovery_disarm_healthy() on a successful product-test response (system/self-recovery/self_recovery.c, documented 'not stock'). Under harness conditions that function is observably inert (recovery not armed -> early return; otherwise touches only MCUCTRL_OTAPOINTER, outside any dumped region), so stock-vs-C traces are identical. Modeled as a local no-op shim; divergence is intended and preserved, not 'fixed'.
notes: Function-level equivalence only. No sources.json/linker/build changes; no git; no flash.
reverification_notes: Re-verified under the final arg-comparing + VFP-aware harness and the global-merge-off build (-fno-common -mllvm -arm-global-merge=false); 0 mismatches in the 2026-11-22 19:12 CST full batch re-run.
